fields.summary_ko.0: Alphabet launched TPU 8tx chips on November 9 that customers can install in their own data centers, securing approximately 100 customers, with Google Cloud Q3 revenue more than doubling year-over-year to $3.07 billion.
fields.summary_ko.1: Cloud backlog reached $56.1 billion (up from $46.2 billion in March) and operating margin expanded to 36.2% (from 23.7% year-over-year), with TPU system sales a meaningful contributor.
fields.summary_ko.2: GOOGL current stock price is $292, down approximately 28% from May peak of $402.62, but long-term investment value is strengthened by chip sales expected to accelerate from 2027 onward.
